item.title: State lawmakers rework bill against schools challenging EdChoice program
item.description: House Bill 671, introduced by State Rep. Jamie Callender (R-Concord), would place state funding in escrow for schools that file lawsuits challenging Ohio's EDChoice voucher program.

item.title: Sen. Husted met with man accused of bribery 2 days before H.B. 6 was introduced, according to schedule
item.description: Senator Jon Husted met with the alleged mastermind of Ohio's largest public corruption scheme two days before scandal-ridden bribery legislation was introduced, according to his official calendar.

item.title: Here's what's next after KYTC pauses controversial Dixie Highway restriping project
item.description: The announcement came after a week of backlash from the community, with residents and business owners expressing frustration over the lack of public input before the project was announced.
